question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Nvidia guided Q3 FY27 revenue to $108.0B +/-2% (no China DC compute). Over the last ~6 quarters actual revenue beat the guide midpoint by 2.5-5.7% (Q2 FY27: 96.2 vs 91.0, +5.7%; Q4 FY26 68.1 vs 65, +4.8%; Q3 FY26 57.0 vs 54, +5.6%; Q2 FY26 46.7 vs 45). Applying a ~4% typical beat gives ~$112-113B. Rubin ramp (20% of DC) and huge supply commitments support the upside; supply/ramp constraints and a consensus near $109B argue against a large beat. No Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold market found. Report expected Nov 17, 2026.

- Vera Rubin production shipments began August 2026; expected ~20% of DC revenue in Q3 (Fool/Yahoo, Sep 2026).
- Long-term supply/capacity commitments rose to $279B as of July 2026 from $119B prior quarter (cryptobriefing preview).
- Sell-side consensus Q3 revenue ~$108.8-109.0B (~45 analysts) (investingly/unusualwhales/Yahoo, Nov 2026).
- Earnings date: Nov 17, 2026 after close (multiple calendars).
- Base rates: actual vs guidance midpoint, over recent quarters: Q2 FY27 +5.7% (96.2 vs 91.0); Q4 FY26 +4.8% (68.1 vs 65); Q3 FY26 +5.6% (57.0 vs 54); Q2 FY26 +3.9% (46.7 vs 45); Q1 FY26 +2.5% (44.1 vs 43, H20 export hit quarter). Q1 FY27 guide not verified this run (recalled ~$78B vs actual 81.6, ~+4.6%).
- Upside candidates: China license re-entry (excluded from guide), faster Rubin ramp. Downside: Rubin yield/HBM supply limits, customer pushouts.
- Status quo: Nvidia has not missed its guide midpoint in the series checked.
- Resolves off Nvidia's first quarterly release after Sep 30, 2026 (Q3 FY27 8-K/press release total revenue), initial figure.
- Event window: report expected Nov 17, 2026; as of Nov 10 not yet reported.
- Searched for Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold contracts: none found.
